scope: One-time independent comparison of current Indonesian OpenIntro Statistics terminology against actual Indonesian statistics/probability field usage, with special attention to the R011-B017 negative-binomial section.

arxiv_search.claim_limit: This is a bounded search result, not a claim that no such arXiv source exists.

Metadata titles and identifiers exposed no suitable Indonesian-language field witness.
The sole result was Italian, not Indonesian.

term_decisions.reason: Directly and repeatedly attested in the primary PDF and in the university module; mathematically exact and idiomatic.
The supplementary university module uses both forms. The adjectival form is the edition's consistent primary label, and the noun form is already retained as a variant.
The primary PDF uses percobaan five times on the defining page. The module alternates percobaan and ulangan; percobaan is clearer as the primary controlled term.
The university module uses saling bebas. The edition already records that exact synonym, while saling independen remains unambiguous and consistent in the reader.
Both witnesses use sukses as the Bernoulli outcome; the primary PDF also uses the natural nominal form keberhasilan.
Both witnesses use gagal/kegagalan with the same mathematical meaning, matching the existing scoped variants.

The primary PDF uses both forms. The edition's existing rule—peluang for event-level values and probabilitas in established field/compound names—fits the observed usage and B017 correctly uses peluang.
The witnesses display factorial notation but do not supply a competing lexical label. Existing glossary evidence and standard Indonesian mathematical usage remain uncontested.
The university module explicitly uses kombinasi for the same counting operation. B017's n pilih k rendering is transparent and mathematically exact.
The primary PDF directly uses nilai harapan in its negative-binomial discussion.
Neither current same-field witness supplies a competing term; the established glossary evidence and consistent edition usage remain controlling.

propagation.action: No propagation is justified. Admit this record as QA evidence only.
